summary: ZenaTech filed a Form 6-K furnishing five Exhibits 99.1-99.5: a CEO shareholder letter citing Q2 2026 revenue of C$9.3M (up 316% year over year, seventh straight sequential gain) and C$17.7M first-half revenue; an update on ZenaDrone 2000 interceptor flight testing; a mobile drone operations trailer launch; Stacklens smart safety glasses; and Q3 guidance of C$13.4M-C$14.8M with over 27% organic DaaS growth. Also notes 29 cumulative DaaS acquisitions. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation or advisor terms are stated; the filing is a routine business update, not a special situation.
